values.note: 2026 rate card: water + electric camping $27 Mon-Thurs, $32 Fri-Sun, $38 holiday; primitive $20; monthly $650; seasonal $1,800. A Mecosta County vehicle permit is required in addition to camping fees ($7 a day at Merrill-Gorrel, or $35 for the annual all-parks permit); the Michigan Recreation Passport is not valid. $5 non-refundable processing fee per site reserved.

values.note: Online on Mecosta County's GoingToCamp site (account required). 'There is a 2-night minimum stay for all campsite/cabin reservations with a 3-night minimum during holiday or event weekends.' Many sites are rented seasonally: all Gorrel sites 57-126 and selected Merrill sites are offered on a seasonal basis.

note: Mecosta County park (RV Life lists town as Sears, on the Mecosta/Osceola line) nestled between Merrill and Gorrel Lakes, 90 acres, with two beaches, two boat launches and direct lake access. --Claude
summary: County pages confirm a 2026 rate of $27 weekday / $32 weekend / $38 holiday (W+E), primitive $20, county vehicle permit $7/day on top (Recreation Passport not valid), $5 processing fee; 146 sites (122 W+E, 24 rustic) + 4 cabins; flush toilets and showers; GoingToCamp booking with a 2-night standing minimum (3 on holiday/event weekends); 2027 season May 7 - Oct 10. Amperage not stated. Note trimmed of site/facility/booking text.
flags: Seasonal share: the county offers 'any of our Gorrel campsites (57-126) or selected Merrill campsites, on a seasonal basis' ($1,800 seasonal, $650 monthly) - up to roughly 70+ of 146 sites, about half. Nightly sites stay on sale through GoingToCamp with posted nightly rates, so long-stay tests 2 and 4 pass.
Phone: the entry's 231-832-3246 is the county parks administration office; the park's own phone is 989-382-7158.
